content.title: Taxable income stays at $0 when gross income is at or below the Single standard deduction
content.intent: Prove taxable income never drops below zero when gross income does not exceed the active deduction.
content.technique_notes: Applied boundary value analysis to the floor-at-zero rule using the authority expansion around the Single deduction threshold 14600: 0, 14599, 14600, 14601. Kept the zero-outcome representatives 0, 14599, and 14600 in this one scenario because they are equivalent for the expected result; split 14601 into a separate scenario because it changes the outcome. Risk-judged interaction strength was 3 because money applies, but no covering array was used because this is a one-input boundary around a specified threshold.
